The largest '''moon''' of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Phaegon III]] contained rich deposits of [[Lignan]] [[Ore/Legends|ore]] beneath its outer crust, where it was home to several [[Species/Legends|species]] of animals. Shortly before the [[Battle of Kirrek (Great Hyperspace War)|Battle of Kirrek]] in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] [[Saes Rrogon]] and [[Yaru Korsin]] [[Mining/Legends|harvested]] the Lignan from the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] for use in the upcoming [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Sith invasion]], exterminating all life on the moon, along with much of the crust. They were [[Skirmish over Phaegon III|ambushed]], however, by [[Relin Druur]] and [[Drev Hassin]].
